message.masteris_bhe.structure.axial_com: The reactor and both axial stabilizers are already complete.

terminal.masteris_bhe.status.desync: Emitter out of line: realign it with the Configurator.
terminal.masteris_bhe.lens.all_fixed: All lenses OK. Press RESET on the control console.
terminal.masteris_bhe.lens.not_needed: Lens is fine. Nothing to recalibrate.

tooltip.masteris_bhe.debug.ignited: Like the Fueled assembler, then presses Ignite.

message.masteris_bhe.debug.no_room: Not enough build height here for a reactor.

message.masteris_bhe.debug.zone.created: Created a dark energy zone (radius %s) centered at %s, %s, %s.
message.masteris_bhe.debug.zone.removed: Removed the dark energy zone centered at %s, %s, %s.
message.masteris_bhe.debug.zone.none: You're not inside a dark energy zone.

message.masteris_bhe.debug.mass.no_ports: This reactor has no Mass Input Ports to fill.

message.masteris_bhe.vent.armed_emergenc: EMERGENCY VENT armed: this burns ALL the mass and destroys the lance. Press CONFIRM within 5 seconds.

message.masteris_bhe.vent.fired_emergenc: EMERGENCY VENT: all the mass burned and the lance is gone. The reactor survives, empty.
message.masteris_bhe.vent.sun: You hit the sun. It flickers. Please don't do that.

message.masteris_bhe.fault.not_fixed: RESET refused: the fault isn't fixed yet.

message.masteris_bhe.horizon.altar_has_k: That key is already set in the altar.
message.masteris_bhe.horizon.trap_enter: Light circles the core... and you see yourself, five seconds ago.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.reactor: The heart of a dark energy reactor: a huge multiblock around a captured black hole. The Reactor Manual shows how to build it, and can project the whole structure into your world.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.containment_box: Throw a Singularity Container into a running reactor's black hole: it pinches off a tiny one and flings it back out as a Containment Box, for the Research Chamber and the Black Hole Bomb.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.recording: Made in the Research Chamber: use the Research Core and recreate this failure on a captured black hole, step by step. Also found in Event Horizon ruins.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.crater: Left at the bottom of a reactor collapse's crater. Event Horizon Fragments also come from Lensing Stalkers, the Echo of the Core and the Singularity.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.zone_ore: Found in a dark energy zone, the area a reactor collapse leaves behind. Mining Unstable Dark Ore sometimes discharges.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.corrupted_mobs: Dropped by corrupted mobs in a dark energy zone's fallout (Graviton Cores rarely). Graviton Cores also come from Graviton Wells in the Event Horizon.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.crystal: Use it on an Unstable Dark Ore node in a dark energy zone to stabilize the node and shrink the zone. The last node belongs to the Echo of the Core.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.horizon_ring: Stand 23 Horizon Frames in a circle with the Horizon Gate at the bottom, feed the gate mass and use it to open a portal into the Event Horizon. Frames can also be salvaged from the Expedition Camp.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.neutronium: Neutronium Ore is found in the Event Horizon's Tidal Depths. Neutronium is worth far more mass than a block: 100 raw, 200 an ingot, 1,800 a block.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.mass_shard: Mass Shard Clusters grow on the Event Horizon's islands. Each shard is worth 16 mass.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.graviton_well: Found on the Event Horizon's islands. Pulls in everything nearby; mine it for a Graviton Core.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.hawking: Hawking Motes come from Hawking Wisps (more if caught early) and Hawking Blooms in the Hawking Garden. A Hawking Cell makes RF on its own.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.horizon_recording: Dropped now and then by Spaghettifiers and Hawking Wisps, and found in the Event Horizon's ruins.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.escape_recording: Hold it for two seconds inside the Event Horizon to get back to the ring you came in by. Also found in the Expedition Camp.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.singularity: The Singularity rises when you use a Singularity Lure deep in the Event Horizon, or set the three Reactor Keys into the altar in the Citadel. Beat it by feeding it unstable matter; it drops the Singularity Heart (10,000 mass).
jei.masteris_bhe.info.reactor_key: Dropped by the Echo of the Core guarding a Frozen Reactor in the Event Horizon, one kind per kind of reactor. The Citadel's altar takes one of each.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.telescope: Found in the Observatory ruin. Fit a Singularity Glass as its lens, then look through it to find the nearest Frozen Reactor (or the Citadel, carrying all three keys).
jei.masteris_bhe.info.light_trap: Found in the Light Trap ruin. Stand on both Light Pads at once (your echo from five seconds ago counts) to open the vault.
jei.masteris_bhe.info.evaporating_rock: What the Hawking Garden's islands are made of. Step on it, or stay near, and it fades away.
